rules.verdict (registered): the verdict is the working-model bar read per model, as the v7 decode blind (docs/registered/2026-11-17-v7-decode-blind-gh200.txt 'certification') and the decode domain blind read it: docs/registered/2026-10-14-decodeB-blind-gh200.txt's rule line 'a model is CERTIFIED when its own bar and the pooled bar hold', carried by addenda 5 and 6 and by both v7 decode blinds. Here each bar (pooled and per model: rms <= 3%, every cell within 8%, |mean| <= 1.5%) is read in B3's two views (ALL and CLEAN, tcommon.timed_page) and combined by rental 2's rule 3 (agreeing views give the verdict; a disagreement reads INCONCLUSIVE, which certifies nothing). A model is CERTIFIED when its combined bar HOLDS, the combined pooled bar HOLDS and the minimum is met
rules.why this verdict: B3's registration decided the bar for 'every NEW blind test' (owner, 2026-11-04, its BAR block) and read it as a conjunction over its own models (E1-TILE); v7's other blind, registered under the same numbers, reads it per model: 'a model is CERTIFIED when its own bar and the pooled bar hold' (decodeB-blind's rule line, carried by addenda 5 and 6 and docs/registered/2026-11-17-v7-decode-blind-gh200 'certification'). One model, v7, with two regimes is read by one rule; B3's two views and rule 3 are kept because they are how a prefill page is read (tcommon.timed_page: ALL and CLEAN)
rules.minimum: MINIMUM (the decode domain blind's rule, docs/registered/2026-11-18-v7-domain-blind-gh200 'minimum', copied): a model is certifiable only when at least 10 of its cells are scored in CLEAN (valid NATIVE cells after the power check, the gates, the page checks (G5 provenance, the r7-median-run3 rebuild, the registered tile), row_drop and G3's voids). A model with fewer is reported with its statistics, labelled BELOW THE MINIMUM and NOT CERTIFIED whatever they read; its scored cells still count in the pooled bar
rules.voids: the power check first (the decode blinds' order; B3's board validity): the board must read c2-power.env C2_POWER_W=700, locks.env LOCK_PROBE_1410=held and G-BAND PASS, and the census gate (v7pcensus) and the sag gate (b3sag) records PASS, else the test is NOT SCORED (exit 1) and nothing is certified. Then B3's page and cell rules, unchanged (docs/registered/2026-11-04-tileB3-gh200.txt TESTS): a page whose provenance (G5: histogram sha256, shuffle seed, counts sha256), rebuild or recorded tile fails is NOT SCORED (its cells are missing); a page whose rebuilt G1 fails is counted in ALL only (voided from CLEAN); a cell failing row_drop (6 of 9 clean, the host rule on the finalised prediction and the timer flag, G4 >= 1405 MHz) is dropped; G3 (rental 7's TOST on uniform minus balanced, r5common.g3_rule): homogeneous and failing, every histogram cell is voided and the test reads NOT SCORED; heterogeneous, the failing strata's non-balanced cells are voided and the verdict is read with those voids (the bar without them printed beside). The decode blinds' GD2 and G3-D voids are decode instruments with no prefill page here; B3's G3 is their prefill counterpart
rules.B3's E1-TILE (DESCRIPTIVE): B3's E1-TILE, DESCRIPTIVE here (docs/registered/2026-11-04-tileB3-gh200.txt TESTS): HOLDS iff the POOLED NATIVE cells AND each blind model meet rms <= 3%, every cell within 8%, |mean| <= 1.5% in ALL and in CLEAN (rule 3); a model CERTIFIED only when E1-TILE HOLDS, its bar holds in CLEAN and at least 2 of its pages are in CLEAN. the fix (part of the frozen model).statement: the v7 gate read PREFILL: NO-GO: REFUSED: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'refit4' (scripts/scoring/v7/gate_v7.out.txt): round 5's r7._rc (scripts/round5_frozen/2026-10-28/round5/work/r7.py) imports refit4 lazily, and round5_chain.chain() pops refit4 from sys.modules after its import. The fix, applied in memory and outside every frozen file exactly as scripts/scoring/v7/prefill_rerun_v7.py applies it: r7._rc returns round5_chain.chain()['RF'], the refit4 module the chain imported. It changes no price (V7.price_prefill never calls r7._rc); it lets round 5's pass estimate (r7.pass_estimates5) run. It is part of the frozen model registered here
the fix (part of the frozen model).source (verbatim):
def apply_fix() -> None:
    """r7._rc returns the refit4 module round5_chain.chain() already imported (prefill_rerun_v7.apply_fix's fix)."""
    C = R5.chain()
    RF = C["RF"]
    assert RF.__name__ == "refit4", RF
    C["r7"]._rc = lambda: RF
